name: SendGrid Health Monitor — Daily Deliverability Check

nodes.name: Config — thresholds & domains
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE HERE: edit 'domains' to your sending domains, adjust thresholds as needed, and set backend_url to your FastAPI deployment URL. Set N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET as an n8n environment variable.

nodes.name: SendGrid GET /v3/stats
nodes.notes: Credential: create an 'Header Auth' credential in n8n named 'SendGrid API Key' with Name=Authorization and Value='Bearer SG.YOUR_KEY_HERE'.

nodes.name: POST /api/v1/outreach/pause
nodes.notes: Reads N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET from n8n environment variables. Set it under Settings > Variables in the n8n UI (or via N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var on the n8n process).
